title: Recover CRC polynomial and bit-order convention

evaluation_metrics.name: word_recovery_rate
evaluation_metrics.description: Fraction of test vectors (messages) for which the final crc_out matches the reference exactly.

evaluation_metrics.name: structural_match_accuracy
evaluation_metrics.description: Whether the submitted RTL implements the correct polynomial and bit-ordering convention (0x1021, MSB-first, no reflection, seed 0xFFFF, no final XOR).

evaluation_metrics.name: functional_equivalence
evaluation_metrics.description: Cycle-accurate match of crc_out against the reference model across all simulation time steps.
